study_identification_part.si_4_title: Developmental trajectories of neuroanatomical alterations associated with the 16p11.2 Copy Number Variations

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: NIHPD (National Institute of Child Health and Human Development) used as normative reference data. SVIP (Simons Variation in Individuals Project) and EU (European 16p11.2 consortium) cohorts provided the 16p11.2 CNV carrier data and site-specific controls.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: As normative reference data for brain growth, we used the multi-site longitudinal data... of the publicly available NIHPD project... (the European -EU 16p11.2 consortium and the Simons VIP -SVIP study in North America)
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: CardenasDeLaParra2019.pdf.md: 2.1.2. General population -NIHPD cohort; 2.1.1. 16p11.2 CNVs cohort

answer.SVIP: clinical research (DEL, DUP) and protocol calibration (CTRL)

answer.EU: clinical research (DEL, DUP) and protocol calibration (CTRL)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: NIHPD (N=339) was used to build the normative mixed-effects models for age and sex. The SVIP and EU datasets provided 16p11.2 deletion (N=56) and duplication (N=19) carriers for clinical evaluation, and 105 controls used to calibrate the model for scanner/protocol differences (1.5T vs 3T).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: we modeled the effect of those 2 variables in the NIHPD normative dataset... After normalization of the 16p11.2 controls, we observed that certain regions required small additional corrections... estimated a linear model... of the 16p11.2 control data... used to adjust the 16p11.2 control dataset

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Train-phase includes 339 children from the NIHPD cohort. Overall-phase (444) includes NIHPD (339) and site-specific controls from the 16p11.2 cohort (105) used for model calibration.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Train phase mean age is 11.0 (NIHPD first scan). Overall phase mean (11.75) is the weighted mean of NIHPD (N=339, mean 11.0) and 16p11.2 CTRL (N=105, mean 14.15). Overall range (4.5 to 22.92) covers both cohorts.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Train-phase (NIHPD): 179F/160M. Overall-phase adds 105 controls (38F/67M) from the 16p11.2 cohort. Total F = 217 (48.9%), Total M = 227 (51.1%).
